review_exit: Accepted by authorized review task; no phase3 rerun.

split.development: Only public phase2/3 histories; same source packet for both G arms, default H0 unchanged. O first transfer O0 is development for B only and excluded from G1 formation and G/H selection.
split.final_test_rules: Freeze selected H for every arm/lineage before any final input is delivered to a participant. S0 host-only final results; do not reselect/tune. The two reserved task files stay byte-identical. O test is same original service with a separately frozen previously unexposed waveform, not a softened service.
split.H0_controls: Fresh matched H0 decisions for three lineages on both selection tasks and all final tests, with exact-input physical cache reuse.

G1_formation_and_cost: Exactly one prospective G1 formation from phase2/3 public experiences, frozen once. Actual request count q allocated deterministically across 3 G1 arms as floor(q/3) plus first q%3 lineage slots; wall and settled USD divided by three. All actual global cost counted once. G0 and G1 arm total caps include those allocations.
selection_rule: Two H descendants per arm/lineage, independently generated from identical H0/history using frozen G0 or G1. Evaluate on same two selection tasks. Choose lexicographically: more complete service PASS, fewer wrong service judgments, fewer total charged requests, then stable descendant index. No-update/invalid is retained; if neither descendant admissible use explicitly labeled H0 fallback. No promotion of global H before heldout comparison.
model: Reuse existing configured gateway/backend and SDK; expected provider-reported deepseek-flash alias; freeze actual configuration hash and reject ambiguity before paid dispatch.
first_actual_exit: One actual O0 transfer candidate and its independent unchanged-contract event service result; paper/long reports follow results.
cache: Immutable initial exact-input snapshot reused per identity, group-isolated overlays; cache hit consumes logical design exposure, not another model history. Changed O energy/program feedback requires complete recomputation.
scope: No new physical qualification or device integration if documents/model missing; execute registered digital BF tasks, record specific missing physical prerequisites. No UI/control architecture expansion.
no_retry: No failed/invalid/censored group replaced. New valid siblings are the two prospectively named descendants, not rescue retries.
publication: Local phase4 paper artifacts only during experiment; final publication synchronization follows existing phase5 authority.
